Name: Red Green Recolor
Author: emurphy42
Description:
Affects the following:
[list]
[*]Energy and health bars
[*]Bar showing how far your fishing cast will go
[*]Bar showing how close you are to reeling in a fish
[*]Bar showing how worn out a fishing tackle is
[*]Something at the Dark Shrine of Memory
[/list]
RGB options are on a percentage scale, however settings may go above 100 or below 0. (Calculated values are increased/decreased as needed.)
[list]
[*]Default options are (0, 0, 200) high to (400, 200, 0) low, which goes from blue to orange to yellow.
[*]Options of (0, 200, 0) high to (200, 0, 0) low are equivalent to base game colors, which go from green to yellow to red.
[/list]
